chunks: The number of months with God is twelve in accordance with God's law since the day He created the heavens and the earth. Of these four are holy. This is the straight reckoning. So do not exceed yourselves during them; but fight the idolaters to the end as they fight you in like manner; and remember, God is with those Who preserve themselves from evil and do the right.

key_terms.فَلاَ تَظْلِمُوا: so do not wrong/do not exceed

ai.seo_question: What are the four holy months in Islam and what is their significance regarding warfare and piety?
ai.summary: This verse from Surah At-Tawbah establishes the divine origin of the lunar calendar, emphasizing the sanctity of four specific months during which warfare was traditionally suspended. In Shia exegesis, this period of truce is often linked to the broader concept of 'Din al-Qayyim' (the upright religion), serving as a temporal framework for maintaining social order and spiritual discipline. The command to fight polytheists collectively is contextualized within the treaty violations of the Meccan era, affirming that God's support remains with the God-fearing (al-Muttaqin) who uphold justice.
